title: 第7章 狮虎兽第8章 怎么会有这么多猎物
slug: 不过是穿梭万界为啥都管我叫爹
content_zh:
对于那些装腔作势、自视甚高的所谓隐士来说，这种方式并不合适。
但对于想尽心尽力为人服务，且无半点虚荣之心的人来说，却是最佳选择。
听完这番话后，众人泪流满面，甚至有些人泣不成声，似乎感觉受了什么极大冲击般反应过度了。
但这完全可以理解，因为在当下这个世界，掌握一种特殊技艺是多么珍贵之事啊。
而这个小伙子竟然要教大家功夫，还不求回报，这种高尚品质真是让人吃惊。
“大伙儿都听童元安兄弟的安排，快收拾一下，马上出发！”
铜木第一个明白过来，立刻指挥着所有人动起来。
不久后，已经分割捆绑好的猎物都被装上了车。
他们总共做了二十辆大推车，当前的猎物只装满了几辆车，还有大部分车是空的。
“既然我们现在可以多带食物，不如再捕一些猎物回去。”
这句话一出，所有人都露出期待的神情。
如果能把这些车子都装满，够整个部落数日之用了。
减少外出就意味着他们活得更长久，毕竟谁也不知道明天会发生什么。
“不行！
童元安兄弟的时间那么宝贵，怎么能浪费在我们身上！”
铜木担忧地看了一眼童元安，生怕他会生气怪罪。
幸好，童元安显得十分平静，这让他更加敬佩不已。
实际上，在铜木心里又何尝不想再多拿些猎物，但是若是因此错失了学功夫的机会，太不划算。
作为队长，他清楚什么事情更重要。
“没关系，顺道的事，大家都想去打猎，那就开始吧。”

童元安点了点头，自己刚刚达到炼气的最高境界，正好需要练练手，对付一些低级妖怪最合适合。
这一决定让大家都对他充满了感激和尊敬。
随后，一行人朝着扶风部落前进。
一路上打打闹闹、捕猎不断。
虽然有了两轮车确实省了不少力，但对于提高众人的战斗能力并无帮助。
遇到妖兽时还是有人受伤严重，不过幸好有童元安准备的神药，才没有造成更大的伤亡。
让大家惊讶的是，童元安虽然拥有强大的能力，但似乎缺乏实际经验，动作相当生疏。
像面对一头普通的野猪精一样，这种妖怪虽然力气很大却笨得可怜，设陷阱轻易就能抓住它。
但童元安却选择了正面硬扛，差点受重伤，弄得自己有些狼狈。
然而很快，人们注意到了有趣的变化。
童元安的动作变得越来越流畅，总能在第一时间发现并打击到妖兽的致命点，出手快速干脆！
content_en:
This approach is not suitable for so-called hermits who are posturing and have a high opinion of themselves.
But it is the best choice for people who want to serve others with all their heart and without any sense of vanity.
After hearing these words, everyone burst into tears, and some even burst into tears, as if they overreacted as if they had suffered a huge shock.
But this is completely understandable, because in today's world, mastering a special skill is so precious.
And this young man actually wants to teach everyone Kung Fu without asking for anything in return. This noble quality is really surprising.
"Everyone, please listen to Brother Tong Yuanan's arrangements. Pack up quickly and set off immediately!"
Tongmu was the first to understand and immediately commanded everyone to move.
Soon after, the prey that had been cut up and tied up was loaded into the car.
They had made a total of twenty carts, and the current prey only filled a few carts, leaving most of them empty.
"Since we can bring more food now, why not catch some more prey and go back."
As soon as these words came out, everyone looked expectant.
If these carts could be filled up, it would be enough for the entire tribe to survive for several days.
Going out less means they live longer, after all, no one knows what will happen tomorrow.
"No!
Brother Tong Yuanan's time is so precious, how can he waste it on us! "
Tongmu glanced at Tong Yuanan worriedly, fearing that he would be angry and blame him.
Fortunately, Tong Yuanan seemed very calm, which made him admire him even more.
In fact, in Tongmu's heart, he doesn't want to get more prey, but if he misses the opportunity to learn kung fu, it is not worth it.
As captain, he knows what is more important.
"It's okay, just a side note. Everyone wants to go hunting, so let's get started."
Tong Yuanan nodded. He had just reached the highest level of Qi refining and needed to practice his skills. He was most suitable for dealing with some low-level monsters.
This decision made everyone full of gratitude and respect for him.
Afterwards, the group of people moved towards the Fufeng Tribe.
There was constant fighting and hunting along the way.
Although having two-wheeled vehicles does save a lot of effort, it does not help improve everyone's combat capabilities.
Some people were seriously injured when encountering monsters, but fortunately, the magic medicine prepared by Tong Yuanan prevented further casualties.
What surprised everyone was that although Tong Yuanan had powerful abilities, he seemed to lack practical experience and his movements were quite unfamiliar.
Just like facing an ordinary wild boar spirit, this monster is very strong but pitifully stupid. You can easily catch it by setting a trap.
But Tong Yuanan chose to carry it head-on, and was almost seriously injured, making himself a little embarrassed.
Soon, however, interesting changes were noticed.
Tong Yuanan's movements become more and more smooth, and he can always find and hit the fatal point of the monster at the first time, and he can strike quickly and decisively!
